title: Bharat Electronics among 4 Sensex stocks to hit 52-week lows; shares fall up to 9% in a month - Downtrend signal | The Economic Times
text:
On Friday, the benchmark Sensex fell 125 points to close at 73,123. Amid the market decline, four Sensex stocks touched fresh 52-week lows, marking their lowest price levels in the past year. A 52-week low represents the lowest price at which a stock has traded over the preceding 12 months and provides an indicator of its recent price performance.

New 52-week low: Rs 354.7| CMP: Rs 360.1. In the last month, the stock has fallen about -9%.

New 52-week low: Rs 292.2| CMP: Rs 298. In the last month, the stock has fallen about -9%.

New 52-week low: Rs 242.3| CMP: Rs 247.2. In the last one month stock has fallen about -8%.

New 52-week low: Rs 1782| CMP: Rs 1820. In the last month, the stock has fallen about -6%.
